reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter all the time, so a sachet that is already counted and goes in my bag is a real fix. $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee is low risk for an impulse buy.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I am not sure bisglycinate alone is enough, and I will not reorder unless I actually feel something.
would_change_my_mind: If the price were closer to $35 for the first box, or if the lab report on the page turned out not to match the batch, I would pass.
